sheets.title: STRUCTURAL CALCULATION REPORT PROJECT: NEW ADU ROOF OVER EXISTING GARAGE (DATE: July 2025) — Roof Framing Summary & Materials / Load Calculations / Notes & Compliance

inputs.Roof Type: Gable roof with prefabricated wood trusses
inputs.Ceiling Type: Uninhabited attic with optional ceiling joists
inputs.Wall Framing: 2x4" Stud Wall with Double Top Plate
inputs.Truss to Top Plate: Simpson H2.5Z hurricane ties at each truss end
inputs.Sheathing Nailing: 10d nails @ 6" edge, 12" field, with panel clips
inputs.Blocking: Solid eave blocking with baffles for ventilation
inputs.Drip Edge & Flashing: Required at all eaves and rakes
inputs.Wind Load (WL): Exposure B, V = 110 mph — As per ASCE 7-16
inputs.Seismic Load: SDS = 1.0, Seismic Design Cat. D — Site Class D (assumed)

results.Sheathing result: Adequate for diaphragm loading in roof system
results.Uplift conclusion: Acceptable — verify with exact truss engineering

sheets.notes: No wind uplift, seismic base shear or diaphragm demand is calculated; uplift "estimated". "Edge/Field" shear capacities are not a valid diaphragm concept. Drawings S-3/S-4 show PRE-ENGINEERING ROOF TRUSS @ 24" O.C. with SIMPSON HI CLIP EACH TRUSS and also 2X10 RAFTER / 2X8 OUTRIGGERS with SIMPSON A36 hurricane clip, vs report H2.5Z and 2x12 rafters; truss submittal not included.

inputs.Support: Ledger at top, concrete pier at bottom

results.6. CONNECTIONS: Stringer to deck ledger: Simpson LSCZ / LSUZ; Tread to stringer: 3 wood screws per end; Post to footing: CB66 / PBS66Z post base; Guardrail posts: 1/2" through-bolts + block; Joists to rim: Simpson LUS hangers
results.7. SUMMARY: All structural members and connections are adequately sized and comply with ASCE 7-16 and NDS. Loads include dead, live, and railing forces. Hardware and footing designs meet code and durability standards.

sheets.notes: No bearing pressure, soil value or reinforcement calc printed.

observations: Lateral system is gypsum-only: every wall W1-W8 uses "gypsum sheathing sheathing on both sides" (1/2'' x 2' x 8' gypsum, 0.120'' nails at 4'', vs = vw = 150 lb/ft, Ga = 4 kips/in) with DF-L stud grade framing; no wood structural panels although drawings reference shear wall edge nailing, HTT holdowns and "SEE SHEAR WALL SCHEDULE" (no schedule printed). Gypsum shear walls in SDC D (SDS = 1) for a second-story ADU.

FAIL printed: W4 and W6 "FAIL - Shear wall aspect ratio exceeds maximum allowable aspect ratio" — sheets stop with no shear/chord/deflection checks. W1, W2, W3, W7 drop segments for aspect ratio > 1.5.
Edition mismatch: W1 cites NDS2018, W2-W8 NDS2015; all walls IBC 2015 cl.1605.3.1; drawings 2022 CRC; reports cite CBC 2022 / ASCE 7-16 / NDS 2018.
W1 uses 2'' x 6'' studs and single 2'' x 6'' end post (Ae 8.25 in2) while W2-W8 and drawings use 2x4 @ 16" with 2 x 2'' x 4'' end posts.

Placeholder loads: W2, W3, W4, W5, W7, W8 identical D = 135 lb/ft, Lf = 60, Lr = 120 lb/ft, W = 135 lbs, Eq = 35 lbs; W1 D = 50, Lf = 10, W = 20, Eq = 15 lbs; W6 D = 20, Lf = 10, Eq = 5 lbs. No seismic/wind base shear calculation exists; existing garage below (walls/foundation supporting new ADU) is not evaluated.

Repeated panel lengths: W1-W4 all b = 22 ft (h = 8 ft) and W6-W8 all b = 10.333 ft (W5 12.333 ft) with differing opening layouts — likely copied inputs; no wall plan dimensions legible in drawing text to confirm.

Roof: drawings show pre-engineered trusses @ 24" with HI clips and also 2X10 rafters with A36 clips; report says H2.5Z ties, 2x12 rafters @ 16"/24", 10d nailing; uplift only estimated (~400–500 lbs vs 635 lbs).

Stairs: calc 3 stringers 2x12 DF-L No.1 (~18" o.c.), riser ~7.5"; drawing S-5: 2 nos. 2"x12" Hem-Fir No.1 or LVL, riser 6", tread run 10"; printed M 1,309 lb-ft and 84.5 lb-ft are slightly off their formulas (~1,305 / ~84.2); post capacity ignores CP; footing 12"x12"x12" with no bearing calc.
